Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post. About the Role By 2030, our organisation will serve 10 million farm families annually. This growth will be fuelled by fundraising, and at One Acre Fund, our fundraising relies on industry-leading grant and partnership management. We have a 10-person grant management team within our larger Business Development department, responsible for stewarding our highest-value donor partnerships, and are now looking for new Strategic Partnerships Senior Associates / Managers to join this team. These roles will manage some of our highest-value donor partnerships, leading the coordination and monitoring of grant-funded activities. All roles will report to leaders within our Global Business Development team, while closely coordinating with leaders for the relevant programs. raw_text: JOB VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT – BANK OF AFRICA RWANDA Position Title: Financial Controller Department: Finance Unit: Reporting Grade: Manager Duty Station: Head Office, Kigali, Rwanda Reports To: Executive Head of Finance 1. ABOUT BANK OF AFRICA – RWANDA BANK OF AFRICA – RWANDA is a private commercial bank operating in Rwanda, providing a comprehensive range of financial solutions to businesses, institutions, and individuals. The Bank commenced operations in Rwanda in October 2015, following the acquisition of AGASEKE Bank, which had been operating in Rwanda since November 2003. Today, BANK OF AFRICA – RWANDA operates 14 branches and a dedicated Business Centre, with eight branches in Kigali and six branches upcountry in Muhanga, Huye, Musanze, Rubavu, Rusizi, and Kayonza. 2. JOB PURPOSE The Financial Controller will support the Bank's budgeting, financial planning, reporting, and management accounting processes. The role contributes to effective budget monitoring, expenditure control, financial analysis, and the preparation of reliable financial information to support management decision-making and business performance. 3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 3.1. Budget Planning and Management Develop and implement budget strategies aligned with the Bank's financial objectives and targets. Participate in the preparation of annual and monthly budgets. Monitor budget execution and ensure alignment with approved financial plans. 3.2. Expenditure Monitoring and Cost Control Monitor daily expenditure and track operating costs against approved budget allocations. Identify budget variances, investigate deviations, and recommend appropriate corrective actions. Recommend cost-saving measures to improve operational efficiency and ensure the effective use of the Bank's resources. High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to analyze financial data effectively. 5. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent financial planning, budgeting, and reporting skills. High proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated ability to build cohesive teams and achieve objectives through teamwork. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in both English and French, written and spoken. title: Civil & Structural Technician
experience_raw: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)
raw_text: Description Job Title: Civil & Structural Technician Department: Infrastructure Duty Station: UGHE, Butaro, Rwanda Reports To: Civil and Structure Engineering Manager Employment Type: Full-time 1. JOB PURPOSE The Civil & Structural Technician will provide practical technical and maintenance support for the University's civil infrastructure, buildings, and external facilities. The position will be responsible for routine inspection, preventive maintenance, minor civil repairs, building-fabric works, site measurements, workmanship checks, defect reporting, and support to approved facilities improvement projects. The successful candidate should be a hands-on, multi-skilled technician capable of working independently on routine tasks while also supporting contractors, artisans, engineers and facilities staff. The position requires good practical knowledge of civil works, basic structural elements, building maintenance, drainage, paving, and general building fabric repairs. The technician will be expected to identify defects and unsafe conditions, carry out authorized remedial works, maintain accurate work records, and promptly escalate major structural, safety or specialist issues to the responsible supervisor. 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Civil Infrastructure Inspection and Maintenance Inspect assigned external civil infrastructure and building elements on a routine basis. Inspect and maintain paths, paving, steps, surface drains, gullies, and minor boundary works. Identify and report on settlement, cracking, blocked drainage, trip hazards, erosion and other defects. Identify potential concerns affecting retaining structures or other structural elements and escalate them appropriately. Carry out authorized minor repairs and maintenance works. Clear authorized drainage blockages and maintain serviceable access routes. Coordinate with gardening and other maintenance staff where vegetation affects drainage, access or civil infrastructure. Maintain accurate inspection and maintenance records. B. Building Fabric and Minor Civil Works Execute approved minor civil and building fabric maintenance works. Undertake practical repairs involving finishes, doors, roofs, drainage and other related building elements where safe and within assigned competence. Prepare work areas, tools, equipment, and materials before commencing assigned tasks. Take measurements and quantities required for maintenance and repair work. Carry out minor masonry, plastering, concrete, paving, drainage and related repair activities. Inspect completed works for workmanship and identify defects requiring correction. Complete assigned snagging and remedial work. Maintain clean, safe, and organized work areas. C. Facilities Improvement and Project Support Support approved civil components of facilities improvement projects. Assist with site measurements, setting out, access arrangements and preparation of materials. Provide practical site support to engineers, project managers, and contractors. Monitor assigned works and provide observations on workmanship, materials, and defects. Assist with snag identification and closure. Support civil interfaces associated with projects such as drainage, water infrastructure, tanks, STP works, grey-water systems, fire-protection infrastructure and other facilities improvements as assigned. Maintain records of site observations, measurements, completed works, and outstanding items. Work within approved drawings, specifications, scope, and instructions. D. Contractor and Workmanship Support Support the Facilities/Infrastructure team in monitoring contractor activities within assigned areas. Verify dimensions, quantities and completed works where assigned. Observe workmanship and report defects or deviations from approved requirements. Assist in preparing areas for contractor activities and coordinating access. Participate in inspections and snagging exercises. Provide evidence of completed works and support project close-out documentation. Escalate major technical, structural or specialist works to the responsible engineer/manager. E. Tools, Materials and Work Planning Prepare required tools, equipment, and materials for assigned work. Ensure appropriate tools are used safely and correctly. Report shortages, damaged equipment, or unsuitable materials. Assist with material measurements and usage records. Maintain tools and equipment in good working conditions. Keep work areas clean and properly protected during maintenance activities. F. Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Compliance Comply with all applicable workplace health and safety requirements. Conduct pre-work checks and identify hazards before commencing activities. Use appropriate PPE and safe working methods. Follow safe procedures for working at height, manual handling, dust-producing activities, access works and use of tools/equipment. Protect building users, staff, visitors and property while carrying out maintenance work. Maintain good housekeeping at all work locations. Promptly report hazards, incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions. Stop and escalate work where conditions exceed the technician's competence or authorization. Maintain required quality and maintenance documentation. G. Documentation and Reporting Maintain complete work orders and maintenance records. Record inspections, defects, measurements, materials used and completed works. Provide photographic or other evidence of completed works where required. Record and follow up on outstanding defects and snags. Provide regular updates to the supervisor responsible. Ensure assigned work orders are properly closed out. Maintain accurate records of safety observations, incidents, and near misses. 3. KEY DELIVERABLES The Civil & Structural Technician will be expected to deliver: Safe and serviceable external civil infrastructure. Timely completion of assigned minor civil and building maintenance works. Accurate inspection and defect records. Properly completed and documented work orders. Effective identification and escalation of structural and major civil defects. Quality workmanship on authorized in-house repairs. Effective support to contractors and facilities improvement projects. Timely closure of assigned snags and defects. Proper material and tool utilization. Compliance with health, safety, and quality requirements. 4. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE Minimum Qualifications Advanced Diploma in Civil Engineering, Civil Engineering Technology, Building Technology, Construction Technology or related technical field. A recognized technical/vocational qualification in civil construction or building works may also be considered supported by relevant practical experience. Experience • Minimum 2–3 years of relevant practical experience in civil works, building maintenance, construction or facilities maintenance. • Practical experience in the maintenance of buildings and external infrastructure is highly desirable. • Experience working with contractors and multidisciplinary maintenance teams is an advantage. • Experience in an institutional, commercial, healthcare, educational, or similar environment is desirable. 5. TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES The candidate should demonstrate practical competence in: General civil construction and maintenance. Concrete and minor reinforced concrete works. Masonry and plastering. Paving and external work. Surface drainage and gullies. Minor building repairs and building fabric maintenance. Basic understanding of structural elements and common structural defects. Basic site measurement and quantity take-off. Reading and interpreting basic construction drawings. Basic setting out and levels. Identification and reporting of construction defects. Basic use and care for construction tools and equipment. Workmanship inspection and snagging. Basic maintenance documentation and reporting. Occupational health and safety procedures. 6. HANDS-ON / MULTI-SKILLED REQUIREMENT The successful candidate should be willing and able to perform practical hands-on duties rather than functioning solely in an office or supervisory capacity. The technician should be capable of assisting with or performing, within their competence and authorization: Minor masonry repairs. Concrete repairs. Plastering and patching. Paving repairs. Drainage cleaning and minor repairs. Kerb and walkway repairs. Minor boundary wall repairs. Door and building fabric repairs. Minor roof-related maintenance support. Painting and surface preparation. Basic carpentry-related building maintenance. General facilities repair and maintenance activities. Preparation of work areas and materials. Site housekeeping and protection. Where a task requires specialist engineering design, structural assessment, major construction, electrical/mechanical expertise or other specialist competence, the technician must escalate the matter to the responsible professional or contractor. 7. BEHAVIOURAL AND PERSONAL COMPETENCIES The successful candidate should demonstrate: Strong practical and hands-on attitude. Reliability and punctuality. Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. Good attention to detail. Strong safety awareness. Good problem-solving ability. Ability to identify and report defects accurately. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to follow instructions, drawings, and technical requirements. Good work discipline and housekeeping. Ability to prioritize maintenance tasks. Professional conduct when working around staff, students, patients, visitors, and contractors. Willingness to learn and undertake different facilities-related tasks within the technician's competence. 8. REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS The Civil & Structural Technician will report to the Civil and Structure Engineering Manager and will work closely with: Civil/Structural Engineers. Facilities and maintenance personnel. MEP technicians. Project managers. Contractors and artisans. Procurement and stores personnel. Security and other relevant institutional departments. 9. AUTHORITY AND LIMITS OF RESPONSIBILITY The technician is authorized to undertake approved routine maintenance and minor civil works within their demonstrated competence. The technician shall not independently approve, design or execute major structural works or specialist works outside their competence. Structural defects, major cracks, significant settlement, major drainage failures, structural instability, major alterations and other high-risk or specialist works shall be promptly reported and escalated to the responsible engineer/manager. Major works and specialist contractor activities remain subject to the University's approved project management, engineering and procurement processes. 10. PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Performance will be assessed against: Completion of assigned maintenance work orders within agreed timelines. Quality and durability of completed repairs. Accuracy and completeness of inspection and maintenance records. Timely identification and escalation of defects and safety risks. Effective closure of assigned snags. Compliance with approved drawings, instructions, and work methods. Compliance with health and safety requirements. Proper use of tools, materials, and equipment. Effective support for projects and contractors. Good housekeeping and protection of institutional facilities. How to Apply Applicants should provide: (1) curriculum vitae, (2) degree, (3) a cover letter describing your interest in UGHE and relevant experience. Please upload these under the ‘Additional Files’ tab on the application page. University of Global Health Equity is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Organizational Profile UGHE is a new kind of university focused on training the next generation of global leaders in health care delivery. The university launched in Rwanda in September 2015. Through an academic experience uniquely rooted in the values of equity, students are empowered to both ease suffering at the bedside and drive transformational, systemic changes to the health system. UGHE is an initiative of Partners In Health (PIH), an internationally recognized non-profit organization whose mission is to provide a preferential option for the poor in health care. In over nearly three decades of operating alongside public sectors in countries around the world, PIH has developed a model to deliver high quality healthcare to some of the world’s most marginalized communities. Nowhere has this impact been more profound than in Rwanda, where Inshuti Mu Buzima—PIH’s sister organization—and our government partners have driven innovation for a decade. Members of the UGHE community are tenacious and resolute in our drive to attain social justice, make common cause with those in need, listen to and learn from others, and operate with honesty and humility as we uphold academic integrity and intellectual curiosity. The University of Global Health Equity seeks individuals committed to these values to join the team. Commitment to Safeguarding and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse, and Sexual Harassment At UGHE, we are committed to ensuring that those who benefit from our work—including community members—as well as our students, contractors, staff, and visitors to our campus are treated with dignity and respect and protected from sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment and any form of systemic abuse, whilst reducing risk and vulnerabilities. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of maintenance technicians, artisans, operators, and contractors; assign work, monitor performance, and coach and develop team members. Plan, coordinate, and supervise preventive, predictive, corrective, and emergency maintenance to ensure maximum equipment availability and reliability, and minimal downtime. Provide engineering support for mechanical, electrical, plumbing, compressed air, ventilation, welding, construction, and utility systems, including the design, installation, modification, and upgrading of plant equipment. Investigate equipment failures, carry out root cause analyses, and recommend engineering improvements. Ensure strict compliance with occupational health, safety, environmental, and statutory requirements, including Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and confined space procedures. Develop maintenance schedules and work plans; coordinate manpower, tools, spare parts, and materials; assist in preparing maintenance budgets and monitor costs. Monitor contractor performance and support procurement by defining technical specifications for spare parts, equipment, and engineering materials. Maintain accurate maintenance records and asset history; prepare periodic performance reports; and track KPIs such as equipment availability, downtime, MTBF, MTTR, and maintenance costs. Drive continuous improvement through reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), preventive maintenance optimization, and operational excellence initiatives. Collaborate with production, procurement, warehouse, health and safety, and other departments, and liaise with equipment manufacturers, consultants, and service providers. Perform any other duties assigned by Management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Electromechanical, or a related Engineering discipline from a recognized institution. Professional certification or registration with a recognized engineering body is an added advantage. Alternatively, an Advanced Diploma or equivalent technical qualification with at least three (3) years of relevant industrial maintenance and engineering experience may be considered. Minimum two (2) years of relevant experience in maintenance and engineering, including at least one (1) year in a supervisory role. Experience in mining, manufacturing, cement production, construction, or other heavy industrial operations is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience supervising multidisciplinary maintenance and engineering teams; experience managing engineering projects and contractors is an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Sound knowledge of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance systems, and of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, welding, plumbing, ventilation, compressed air, and utility systems. Knowledge of engineering drawings, technical specifications, equipment installation and commissioning, reliability engineering, and asset management principles. Good understanding of occupational health, safety, and environmental regulations. Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS); knowledge of CMMS and ERP maintenance modules is highly desirable. Strong leadership, planning, coordination, analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure. Excellent report writing, documentation, and interpersonal skills; high level of integrity, professionalism, and accountability. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; working knowledge of AutoCAD or other engineering software is an added advantage. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and Kinyarwanda. Physically fit and willing to work overtime, weekends, or respond to emergency breakdowns when required. How to Apply Interested and qualified candidates should send one single-file PDF application document to bigminingcompanyltd@gmail.com , with a copy to nshizirunguthierry@gmail.com, addressed to: The General Manager, Big Mining Company Ltd Please write "Job Application – Maintenance & Engineering Supervisor" in the subject line of the email. The single PDF file must contain, in this order: A cover letter (maximum 1 page); A Curriculum Vitae (maximum 3 pages); Three (3) references with names, positions, and phone numbers, including your most recent supervisor; Copies of work certificates; Copies of academic and training certificates; A copy of your national ID; A recommendation letter (an added advantage). Deadline for submission: 26th October 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Applications received after the closing date, or that do not meet the requirements above, will not be considered. Big Mining Company Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Done at Ruhango on 12 October 2026 SHUMBUSHO Eugene General Manager Big Mining Company Ltd Apply

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
raw_text: Senior Human Resources Manager - Rwanda Location: Rwanda (Kagano) Company: Kivu Choice Reports To: Group HR Operations Director Direct Reports: HR Managers, Recruiters, HR Administrators, and Learning & Development Coordinators. About Kivu Choice: Kivu Choice is Rwanda’s largest protein producer and one of the fastest-growing aquaculture companies in Africa. Founded in 2022, Kivu Choice is the sister company to Victory Farms, East Africa’s leading aquaculture platform based in Kenya. The company operates a fully vertically integrated aquaculture model, encompassing hatchery operations, cage-based grow-out, processing, distribution, and sales. Kivu Choice is also one of the country’s largest employers, with over 700 employees, and plans to grow to 1,200 employees within the next three years, reflecting its strong commitment to job creation and inclusive economic development. Over the next five years, Kivu Choice aims to scale into Africa’s largest and most sustainable protein producer, producing and distributing 30,000 tons of fish annually for the Rwandan market and for export across the region. Job Purpose The Senior Human Resources Manager will lead and oversee all human resources functions for Kivu Choice Rwanda, ensuring alignment with Group HR strategy, business objectives, and local labor law requirements. The role is responsible for driving HR operations excellence, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, learning & development, workforce planning, organizational development, compliance, and employee engagement. The incumbent will serve as a strategic HR partner to country leadership while ensuring effective execution of operational HR initiatives that support business growth, organizational effectiveness, and employee productivity. Key Responsibilities HR Strategy & Business Partnership Implement group HR strategies, policies, and initiatives within Rwanda. Partner with Country Leadership and Functional Heads to align workforce plans with business objectives. Provide strategic HR guidance on organizational design, workforce optimization, talent management, and culture development. Support organizational growth initiatives, restructuring, and change management programs. Drive consistent implementation of Group HR standards and governance frameworks. Human Resources Operations Lead all HR operational activities, including onboarding, employee lifecycle management, records management, and HR administration. Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of HR data and employee records. Develop and implement HR service delivery standards and continuous improvement initiatives. Manage HR budgets and ensure cost-effective utilization of resources. Oversee HR systems and reporting requirements. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning Lead recruitment and workforce planning activities across all business functions. Ensure robust sourcing, assessment, and selection processes. Build strong talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill positions. Partner with management to identify current and future workforce needs. Monitor recruitment metrics and hiring effectiveness. Employee Relations & Industrial Relations Lead employee relations matters and promote positive employee-employer relationships. Manage disciplinary processes, grievance handling, investigations, and conflict resolution. Ensure consistent application of policies, procedures, and labor law requirements. Advise managers on employee relations issues and people management matters. Support engagement with labor authorities and external stakeholders where required. Performance Management & Talent Development Drive performance management cycles and ensure organizational compliance. Support managers in setting objectives, conducting reviews, and implementing development plans. Identify capability gaps and coordinate learning interventions. Facilitate succession planning and talent review processes. Build internal talent pipelines for critical positions. Leadership Development & Organizational Effectiveness Coach managers and leaders on leadership effectiveness and people management. Support development of future leaders through structured development programs. Lead organizational development initiatives and culture transformation activities. Drive employee engagement and retention strategies. Compensation & Benefits Support implementation and administration of compensation and benefits programs. Conduct salary benchmarking exercises and provide recommendations. Ensure payroll inputs are accurate and submitted on time. Monitor employee benefit programs and vendor performance. Compliance & Governance Ensure compliance with Rwanda labor laws and statutory requirements. Implement Group HR policies, procedures, and controls. Coordinate HR audits and compliance reviews. Maintain legal and regulatory compliance across all HR processes. Prepare HR reports and workforce analytics for management review. A master's degree in human resources, MBA, organizational development, or a related field is strongly preferred. Professional Qualifications One or more of the following: CIPD SHRM-SCP / SHRM-CP HRCI Certification CHRP(K) IHRM Certification Equivalent professional HR qualification Experience Minimum 15 years of progressive human resources experience. At least 5 years in a senior HR leadership or managerial role leading HR teams. Experience managing HR functions within large, fast-paced organizations. Experience in manufacturing, production, agribusiness, FMCG, logistics, or similar operational environments preferred. Strong experience in employee relations, talent management, recruitment, organizational development, and HR operations. Experience working within a multi-site or multi-country environment is highly desirable. Demonstrated track record of leading organizational change and HR transformation initiatives. Key Competencies Leadership Strategic Leadership People Management Team Development Executive Presence Decision Making Human Resources Expertise HR Operations Management Talent Acquisition Workforce Planning Employee Relations Industrial Relations Performance Management Succession Planning Organizational Development Compensation & Benefits Labor Law Compliance Business Skills Strategic Thinking Business Acumen Stakeholder Management Project Management Budget Management HR Analytics and Reporting Change Management Problem Solving Travel Requirements Travel within Rwanda and occasional travel to Group locations as required. Approximately 20%-30% travel depending on business needs and projects. They will act as the primary HR advisor to country leadership and a key partner to the Group HR Operations Director in executing the Group's people strategy. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis as they are submitted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Apply

title: Senior Internal Auditor
experience_raw: Mid career (3 to 5 years of experience)
raw_text: VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT INGANJI SACCO RUBAVU is a Savings and Credit Cooperatives, located in Western Province, Rubavu District within 12 sectors across RUBAVU District. INGANJI SACCO RUBAVU established following the consolidation of 12 Umurenge Savings and Credit Cooperative (U-SACCO's). INGANJI SACCO RUBAVU is looking for qualified, competent, committed, proactive and self-motivated individual to occupy the following position. Senior Internal Auditor (1) Department: Audit and Compliance Reporting to: Managing Director. Number of positions: 1 Job Summary We invite applications for the position of Internal Auditor. The Internal Auditor at Inganji SACCO Rubavu plays a critical role in strengthening governance, risk management, and internal controls within the SACCO. The position ensures that operations, financial reporting, and compliance practices adhere to internal policies, applicable laws in Rwanda, and best financial practices. The Senior Internal Auditor reports to the Audit Committee of the Board (functionally) and administratively to the Managing Director. Duties and Responsibilities: Under the supervision and guidance of the Managing Director, the Senior Internal Auditor shall be responsible for performing the following duties and responsibilities: To follow the principles and rules governing the conduct of the Cooperative's business activities; To prepare a monthly, quarterly and annual audit plan based on activities that appear to be likely to cause damage or waste the Cooperative's assets; Ensure that internal audit guidelines and principles are properly followed to prevent errors or possible malpractices; Report any shortcomings in the daily operations of the department with a view to preventing theft, embezzlement and misuse of funds; Establish a table of issues identified by the audit, recommendations made by the audit and the methods for their implementation; Review whether the internal audit system is working properly, identifying strengths and areas for improvement, and providing recommendations for action; Review whether the accounting has been carried out in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), the regulations of the Central Bank of Rwanda (BNR), and that the information contained is complete and reliable to assist in making informed decisions; Verify whether all activities of the Cooperative comply with applicable laws and regulations; Analyze the efficient and effective use of the Cooperative's resources to achieve its objectives; Monitor and analyze the causes of problems in order to determine methods and strategies to solve and prevent them; Maintain proper records and audit evidence; Conduct a special audit of the funds on hand and verify how these funds are used and authorized, to ensure that no errors are made; Verify that shares, deposits, loan payments, and interests are correctly recorded in the Cooperative's IT system and ensure that they are properly processed; Review whether loan files are completed as required by the loan policy, the loan disbursement and repayment procedures, and ensure that loan and interest payments are properly processed; Review and confirm that all outstanding debts have been recovered as planned; Prepare periodic reports on internal audits, showing whether the operating procedures and regulations are being followed; Review the bank statements and corresponding documents and verify that the Cooperative's assets are properly protected; Monitor the implementation of the resolutions of the meetings issued by the competent authorities; Provide advice on all irregularities and submit them to the relevant authority; Submit internal audit plans and reports to the supervisor; Supervise the work carried out by other employees; Supervise the implementation of the strategic& business plans, action plan and budget; Timely prevent and disclose any conflicts of interest or lack of segregation of duties; Perform other duties that are not contrary to the laws and regulations required by the supervisor, employer or superior body. Qualifications & Experience, Conditions required: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. Three (3) years of experience in auditing, and a thorough understanding of Microfinance Banking and accounting practices. Good strategic thinking, with risk and control consciousness. Having a Professional Qualification in Accouting or auditing ( eg, CPA, ACCA, ) is an added Advantage Applicants must be Rwandan by nationalilty. Applicants must be not more than 45 years of age at the time of application. High attention to detail and excellent analytical skills. Excellent communication skills Professionalism and integrity. Proven knowledge of auditing standards and procedures, laws, rules and regulations. Advanced computer skills on MS Office or Core Banking Software. How to apply All interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their applications with a cover letter (indicating their motivation, suitability, knowledge and experience), Curriculum Vitae, copies of their academic, professional and training certificates and copies of identity cards or passports in one Pdf document by email to inganjisaccorecruitment@gmail.com or Hardcopy at HQ not later than Tuesday, 20/10/2026 at 5:00 pm. Apply

title: Procurement Officer
experience_raw: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)
raw_text: GAMICO Ltd Job Vacancy Announcement POSITION:PROCUREMENT OFFICER Company :GAMICO Ltd Location: Bashyamba Concession, Kigali Sector, Nyarugenge District, Rwanda Employment type: Full-time Reports to: Supply chain Section Leader Application deadline: 28th October 2026 About Us GAMICO Mining Company is one of the leading tin producers in Rwanda, operating at the Bashyamba concession in Kigali Sector, Nyarugenge District. With more than ten years of experience, we have built a strong reputation for quality production, safe operations, and responsible mining. We are committed to environmental stewardship and to the development of the communities in which we operate. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Officer to join our team and help us source mining equipment, materials, and services efficiently, transparently, and at the best value. Key Responsibilities Purchase Requests and Planning Receive purchase requests from the stores and departments, and confirm that each one is properly completed and approved before any action is taken. Check the item description, specification, quantity and budget availability on every request. Plan purchases using stock levels and supplier lead times, and place orders in good time—ideally two weeks before consumable stock runs out—so nothing runs short. Combine similar requests where possible to obtain better prices and reduce the number of orders. Sourcing and Quotations Follow the procurement method set out in the company's Procurement Manual for every purchase, and obtain the quotations or bids that the method requires. Identify and maintain a list of reliable, approved suppliers for all goods, materials, equipment and services needed by the company. Compare the quotations or bids received on price, quality, delivery time and payment terms, and prepare the comparison for approval as required by the Procurement Manual. Negotiate prices and terms with suppliers in the best interest of the company, within the limits of the Procurement Manual. Confirm that the selected supplier is registered and can issue a valid EBM invoice. Purchase Orders Prepare and issue a PO to the selected supplier only after the purchase has been approved. State on every PO the item description, quantity, unit, agreed price, delivery date and delivery place. Record every PO in the Excel PO register, showing PO number, supplier, items, amount, order date, expected delivery date and status. Follow up with suppliers to make sure goods are delivered on the agreed date, and inform the requesting department and the store of any delay. Delivery, Invoices and Payment Support Work with the Store Keepers and the Equipment Store Officer to make sure every delivery is physically counted and matched against the PO, the supplier delivery note and the EBM invoice, and that the price agrees before the invoice is passed for payment. Resolve shortages, damaged goods, wrong items and price differences with suppliers, and arrange returns, replacements or credit notes. Hand over the complete set of documents (PO, delivery note and EBM invoice) to the Equipment Store Officer for receiving in QBO, and to Finance for payment. Supplier Management Evaluate supplier performance regularly on quality, delivery time, price and service. Handle any claim about the quality of goods supplied directly with the supplier, supported by the Store Keeper's and the user department's records. Keep supplier contracts, agreements and contact details up to date and filed. Report poor or unreliable suppliers to the Procurement Section Leader, with a recommendation on whether to continue buying from them. Records and Reporting Keep all procurement documents (requests, quotations, comparisons, POs, delivery notes, EBM invoices) filed in order and available for audit. Prepare a weekly and monthly procurement report showing purchases made, pending orders, late deliveries and cost savings. Ethics and General Responsibilities Act with honesty and integrity, and avoid any conflict of interest in dealing with suppliers. Do not accept gifts, favours or payments from suppliers or potential suppliers. Follow company procurement policies and procedures, and the applicable laws and tax requirements. Perform any other related duties assigned by the Procurement Section Leader. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Economics or a related field [2-3] years of relevant procurement experience, preferably in mining, construction, or another heavy industry Professional certification (e.g., CIPS) is an added advantage Solid knowledge of procurement procedures, contract management, and tendering processes Familiarity with mining equipment and supply chains is an added advantage Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills What We Offer Competitive salary commensurate with experience Health insurance Opportunities for professional development and career growth A safe, collaborative, and supportive work environment How to Apply Send your CV and a cover letter to info@gamico.rw with the subject line "Procurement Officer Application" by 28th October 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Done at Kigali on 14th October 2026 IMENA Evode General Manager GAMICO Ltd Apply

title: Responsable Risque et Conformité
raw_text: ATLANTIQUE MICROFINANCE est une institution de microfinance qui donne des services financiers tels que des crédits et des services d'épargne à ses clients. ATLANTIQUE MICROFINANCE Plc est enregistrée comme société de microfinance au Rwanda depuis 2018 et dispose d'un certificat d'autorisation de prestation de services de microfinance délivré par la Banque centrale du Rwanda (BNR). AVIS DE RECRUTEMENT Afin d’accompagner son développement et renforcer ses équipes, ATLANTIQUE MICROFINANCE Rwanda Plc recrute : Un Responsable Risque et Conformité. RESPONSABLE RISQUE ET CONFORMITE Rattachement hiérarchique : Directeur Général A. Description Générale : Le responsable Risque et Conformité est le garant de la conception et la mise en place des stratégies permettant une meilleure surveillance et prévention contre toutes sortes de risques de la société ATLANTIQUE MICROFINANCE RWANDA. B. Missions principales : Elaborer le registre des risques ; Identifier et évaluer les différents types de risques (financiers, opérationnels, de crédit, de marché, de liquidité, etc.) auxquels l'institution pourrait être exposée. Développer la cartographie des risques de l’institution Mettre en place des mécanismes de surveillance pour assurer un suivi continu des risques et ajuster les stratégies en fonction de l’évolution de l’environnement économique et réglementaire. Élaborer et proposer des mesures de mitigation des risques afin de réduire les risques à un niveau acceptable. Suivre l’évolution des lois, régulations et normes applicables au secteur de la microfinance, tant au niveau national qu’international. Vérifier que l'ensemble des opérations et activités de la microfinance respecte les exigences légales, réglementaires et les bonnes pratiques du secteur. Préparer et soumettre les rapports requis par les autorités de régulation, en s'assurant de leur exactitude et de leur conformité. Former les collaborateurs sur les pratiques de gestion des risques et de conformité. Développer des politiques et des procédures internes adaptées à la gestion des risques et à la conformité pour l'ensemble du personnel. Identifier, traiter et résoudre rapidement les situations de non-conformité ou les incidents de risques qui pourraient affecter l’intégrité et la réputation de la microfinance. Développer des plans d'action de gestion des risques et conformités. Fournir des rapports réguliers à la direction générale sur l'état de la gestion des risques et de la conformité au sein de l’institution. Communiquer et entretenir des relations avec les autorités réglementaires, en veillant à la transparence et à la bonne conduite de la microfinance. Mettre en œuvre et maintenir le programme de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent et le financement du terrorisme. Implémenter un plan de continuité opérationnelle (business continuity plan) pour éviter qu’une interruption d’activité ne nuise à la société. C. Profil recherché : Une licence ou une maitrise en Gestion des Risques, Commerce, Management, Finance ou domaine connexe Minimum 4 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des risques et de la conformité idéalement en microfinance ou dans le secteur bancaire. Et doit être capable de parler couramment, écrire le français(obligatoire), l’Anglais et le Kinyarwanda. La maîtrise de différents outils technologiques ; La maîtrise des normes de sécurité financière, organisationnelle, écologique... Bonne connaissance des principes et pratiques de gestion des risques financiers Intégrité, rigueur, esprit d’analyse et de synthèse. Bonne aptitude managériale. Et avoir des Connaissances en Audit est un atout Les candidats intéressés par la présente offre et dont le profil répond aux critères mentionnés ci-Haut sont invités à envoyer : Une lettre de motivation, Une copie de la carte d’identité nationale, Un curriculum vitae (CV) détaillé, Des copies des diplômes universitaires et professionnels. Ces documents doivent être envoyés en utilisant l’adresse email suivant : recrutementrwanda@amifa-rw.net La date limite des dépôts des dossiers est fixée au 27/10/2026 à 17h00, Seuls les candidats sélectionnés seront contactés. Fait à Kigali, Le 12/10/2026 Mary LAMBASHA Directrice Générale Adjointe Attachment attachment_file_6e4da9b9461e2ca35d5b Apply

title: Production Supervisors / Line Officers
experience_raw: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)
raw_text: PRODUCTION SUPERVISORS / LINE OFFICERS 1. Overview HAARZOPF Ltd is a manufacturing company, initiated investment in Rwanda in manufacturing of hair products. HAARZOPF Ltd is closer to start operations in Kigali with one factory. This factory will work with international companies and local partners. The factory mission is to satisfy at high level its international and local clients with the produced high qualified products. In order to achieve our mission to our clients we need a sharp line officer. This role is essential to make sure that products meet client’s quantity and quality standards. He/she will play a critical role to meet targets of the daily production. He/she will lead workers working in production line under his/her responsibilities, to maximize the produce of production line in big quantity and perfect quality. He will play a critical role in managing the daily production, fostering line team collaboration. Job Title:Production Supervisors / Line officers Reports To:Production Subdivision Manager (PSDM), 2. Job Description Production Supervisor / Line Officer is responsible for organizing effectively the workers team allocated to a production line, operating and maintaining equipment on a production line to meet production daily, weekly, monthly targets and ensure quality standards. This role involves tasks like operating machinery, inspecting the workers, and following production schedules. They may also be responsible for troubleshooting issues, reporting defects, and maintaining a clean and safe work environment. The Production Supervisors / Line Officers ensure all manufacturing goes smoothly and efficiently by closely monitoring how workers operate their work. A Production Supervisor / Line Officer is integral in a fast-paced production environment. 3. Scope of Work And Duties Supervising operations within a facility to achieve higher output Make daily, weekly and monthly reports of every worker under his production line Submit the daily, weekly and monthly report to his/her subdivision manager on time Organizing training and educational manuals for the production team Assisting in the recruitment and onboarding of new workers Handling supply and inventory of raw goods in the production line Ensuring compliance with safety and professional standards within factory premises Organizing, monitoring, and prioritizing tasks to meet production goals Evaluating various stations of the production operation to ensure optimum efficiency Maintaining communication between workers and subdivision manager and division manager to ensure procedures and policies are well-understood Inspect the products for quality and size specifications Check the quality and count the correct number of products that should go for next stage Notify the subdivision manager of any problems that arise on the production floor Follow and assist the workers to implement all company policies and safety protocols Participate in the production meetings Write and submit attendance list of workers on daily basis 4. Character Traits: Knowledge of operational processes for factory production line Excellent organization, communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills Excellent problem-solving skills, and a strong work ethic Ability to write reports legibly and accurately mainly using data management software Relevant training and certification in industrial production, engineering, or any related field Flexible schedule 5. Targets Daily production line target output Weekly production line target output Monthly production line target output Quality standard 6. Experience Required Minimum Experience required. Managing tasks and coming up with solutions. Dynamic and go-getter attitudes. 7. Qualifications Secondary School diploma. Intermediate knowledge of English and Microsoft Office. Strong skills in efficient time and deadline management and ability to work in a team environment. High interpersonal skills, creativity and consequent in action. Able to stand for extended periods Attention to detail Get training in HAARZOPF Academy for 6 months at least. 8. Job Duration Entire job duration will be 1 year; extension of this is possible based on performance. Duty Hours 6 Day -8 hours/ day Probation Period 3 months If you meet the requirements please your CV and Cover later to gpm-ast.hz@sharmail.biz Apply

title: Assistant Teacher Trainer - Inclusive Education
experience_raw: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)
raw_text: JOB OPPORTUNITY Assistant teacher trainer-Inclusive Education Location: Kigali-Rwanda Contract:One year renewable ABOUT THE MOYO CENTER The Moyo Center is a Rwanda-based organization working to strengthen inclusive education through teacher training, professional development, research, curriculum development, and community building. Our goal is to help create educational environments where children with disabilities, including children with autism and other learning and developmental differences, can meaningfully learn, participate, and thrive. THE OPPORTUNITY We are looking for an enthusiastic, practical, and growth-minded Assistant Teacher Trainer – Inclusive Education to join our team. The successful candidate will work closely with our Senior Teacher Trainers to co-facilitate professional development, assist in school coaching, support demonstration classrooms, and help design practical learning materials for partner schools. This role is ideal for an educator with strong classroom experience or early experience in teacher support who is eager to build their skills in adult training, coaching, and inclusive curriculum development. PURPOSE OF THE ROLE The Assistant Teacher Trainer will support the planning and delivery of training programs that equip teachers with the skills to support learners with diverse needs. The role involves co-facilitating workshops, assisting with classroom observations and follow-ups, supporting resource creation, and contributing to a continuous learning model across partner schools. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Training Assistance & Co-Facilitation Assist in preparing and co-delivering interactive, practical training sessions for teachers and school staff. Help set up and facilitate workshops, small group discussions, hands-on activities, and classroom simulations. Support the gathering of participant feedback and assist in adapting materials to meet teacher needs. 2. Inclusive Education Practice & Support Support teachers in implementing foundational inclusive strategies, including differentiated instruction, positive behavior support, classroom accommodations, and communication tools. Support strategies tailored for learners with autism, learning disabilities, and other developmental differences. 3. Coaching, Observation & Follow-Up Conduct follow-up visits to partner schools to observe classroom practice under the guidance of senior trainers. Provide constructive, encouragement-focused feedback to teachers. Help model effective inclusive techniques alongside classroom teachers. Assist in tracking teacher progress and identifying common classroom challenges. 4. Materials & Content Development Assist in drafting and organizing training presentations, handouts, visual aids, and low-cost classroom learning materials. Support the contextualization of inclusive education tools for the Rwandan school context. 5. Demonstration Classrooms & Documentation Assist in setting up and maintaining model inclusive classrooms. Help document success stories, lessons learned, and training data for monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) purposes. 6. Stakeholder Engagement Maintain positive, respectful relationships with teachers, school administrators, and families during school visits and training events. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Required Rwandan nationality. Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Education, Special Needs Education, Inclusive Education, Psychology, or a related field At least 1 to 3 years of direct teaching experience or early experience assisting in teacher training/coaching. Basic understanding of child-centered learning and inclusive education principles. Good facilitation, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Professional fluency in written and spoken English. Fluency in Kinyarwanda. Strongly Preferred Direct experience teaching or supporting learners with autism, intellectual disabilities, or special educational needs. Experience creating practical teaching aids or learning materials. Familiarity with Rwandan public school contexts and basic inclusive education guidelines. HOW TO APPLY Please submit the following documents to olivier@aeprogram.org: Updated CV / Resumé Cover letter detailing your experience and interest in inclusive education Contact details for two professional referees Email Subject: Application – Assistant Teacher Trainer – Inclusive EducationDeadline: 26th October, 2026 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. The Moyo Center is committed to inclusion, equal opportunity, safeguarding, and creating a safe and respectful environment for all children, educators, and staff. Apply

title: Plumber
experience_raw: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)
raw_text: JOB OPPORTUNITY ANNOUNCEMENT Date: October 12, 2026 Shagasha Tea Company Ltd is one of Rwanda’s leading tea producers, located in the lush and fertile highlands of Rusizi District, Western Province. The company is dedicated to the cultivation, processing, and marketing of high-quality tea for both local and international markets, is seeking to recruit dynamic, self-motivated, and qualified individuals to fill the following vacant position: Job Title: PlumberDepartment: Engineering / MaintenanceReports to: Head of Maintenance/Head of engineeringLocation: Tea Factory Job Purpose The Plumber is responsible for installing, maintaining, repairing, and inspecting plumbing systems throughout the tea factory to ensure the continuous and efficient operation of production processes. The role includes maintaining water supply systems, steam and condensate piping, drainage systems, sanitation facilities, and supporting preventive maintenance activities while complying with safety, environmental, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities: Plumbing Installation and Maintenance Install, repair, and maintain water supply, drainage, and wastewater systems within the factory. Install and maintain industrial piping systems for water, steam, compressed air, and condensate where applicable. Replace damaged pipes, fittings, valves, taps, pumps, and plumbing fixtures. Maintain sanitary facilities, including toilets, washrooms, sinks, and changing rooms. Ensure proper functioning of drainage systems to prevent blockages and flooding. STEAM and Preventive Maintenance Maintain and repair steam pipelines, valves, joints, steam traps, and condensate-return systems. Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance to prevent steam leaks, equipment failures, and production downtime. Ensure safe steam-system maintenance through proper isolation, depressurization, and compliance with safety procedures. Monitor and report abnormal pressure, water hammer, corrosion, and other steam-system defects. Minimize steam and energy losses by maintaining insulation and ensuring efficient condensate recovery. Respond to steam-system breakdowns and emergencies within the scope of authorization. Coordinate steam maintenance activities with boiler operators, production, and engineering teams. Perform scheduled inspections of plumbing installations according to the maintenance plan. Corrective Maintenance Respond promptly to plumbing breakdowns that affect production or factory operations. Diagnose plumbing faults and implement effective repairs. Minimize equipment downtime through timely troubleshooting and repair. Coordinate with electricians, mechanics, and production teams during maintenance activities. Water Supply and Utility Management Monitor factory water distribution systems to ensure uninterrupted supply. Inspect water tanks, pumps, pressure systems, and pipelines for leaks or inefficiencies. Assist in monitoring water consumption and recommend water-saving measures. Ensure wastewater and drainage systems comply with environmental standards. Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance Follow all occupational health and safety procedures during maintenance activities. Properly use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Ensure plumbing work complies with applicable building codes and factory standards. Report unsafe conditions immediately. Maintain a clean and organized work area after completing maintenance tasks. Documentation Record completed maintenance activities in maintenance logs. Report recurring plumbing issues and recommend corrective actions. Maintain inventory records for plumbing materials and spare parts. Assist in preparing maintenance reports. Continuous Improvement Recommend improvements to plumbing systems for increased efficiency and reliability. Support factory improvement projects and equipment upgrades. Participate in maintenance planning and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree or Advanced Diploma in Plumbing or a related technical field. Experience Minimum of 2 years of practical plumbing experience in an industrial environment, preferably in a tea factory, food processing plant, manufacturing facility, or similar industry. Technical competencies Strong knowledge of industrial plumbing systems, water supply, drainage, sewage, especially STEAM piping systems. Ability to read plumbing drawings and technical diagrams. Experience using plumbing tools and testing equipment. Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance practices. Basic understanding of pumps, valves, and industrial utility systems. Familiarity with workplace health and safety regulations. Behavioral competencies Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Attention to detail. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Good communication and teamwork skills. Time management and ability to prioritize maintenance tasks. High level of integrity and accountability. Willingness to work flexible hours during emergencies or factory shutdowns. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Response time to plumbing breakdowns. Preventive maintenance completion rate. Number of repeat plumbing failures. Downtime caused by plumbing issues. Compliance with safety procedures. Quality and timeliness of maintenance documentation. Efficient use of plumbing materials and spare parts. Water loss reduction and leak prevention. How to Apply: Interested and qualified candidates should submit their applications in one PDF document addressed to the Managing Director, Shagasha Tea Company Ltd, by email to: recruitment@shagashateas.com Deadline for application is not later than October 31, 2026, at 5:00 PM Application documents must include: A signed application letter Curriculum Vitae (CV) with at least three referees Copy of academic certificates Any other relevant supporting documents Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Done at Shagasha on 12/10/2026 Managing Director/Shagasha Tea Company Apply

On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience.
